contact_sheet_review.method: 39 contact sheets total across both profiles; gross layout only, not full-text reading

Some standalone TOCs spill onto a sparse second page; acceptable for regression pilot, not a visual profile freeze.
Clause index p231 inspected visually; all index destinations and printed page numbers are separately covered by automated audit.
